analysis.title: National Fuel Gas Co. (NFG): First Take: Strong Adj. EPS Beat Versus GS and Consensus; Focus on IUG Operations and F2027 EPS Guidance
key_insights: NFG reported F4Q26 adjusted EPS of $1.22 vs GS estimate of $1.16 and consensus of $1.04, a 5% beat vs GS and 17% vs consensus.

F4Q26 EBITDA of $297 mn was 1% below both the GS estimate ($301 mn) and FactSet consensus ($301 mn). Pipeline & Storage and Utility EBITDA beat GS estimates, offset by misses in Integrated Upstream and Gathering.
F4Q26 total production of 1,130 MMcfe/d was 5% below GS (1,190) and consensus (1,188) estimates.
F4Q26 capex of $346 mn was above the GS estimate of $324 mn and consensus of $322 mn.
F4Q26 operating cash flow before working capital changes was $289 mn vs GS $248 mn (+17%) and consensus $241 mn (+20%).

F2027 guidance: adjusted EPS of $6.00-$6.40 at a maintained $2.85/MMBtu NYMEX price, total production of 400-435 Bcf vs GS/consensus of 425/424 Bcf, and capex of $1,090-$1,220 mn vs consensus of $1,075 mn.

The note lists four questions for the 9 AM ET call: the decision to spin off the Integrated Upstream and Gathering business, regulated growth outlook across Pipeline and Utility, further in-basin supply agreements, and the drivers of F4Q26 production and capex vs guidance.
GS is Not Rated on NFG and has no price target or estimates published in the note. GS discloses it is acting as financial advisor on an announced strategic matter involving National Fuel Gas.

market_movers.rationale: GS is Not Rated because it is advising on a strategic transaction involving NFG. The note is a first take on F4Q26 results and F2027 guidance, with no rating or target.

earnings_insights: NFG F4Q26 adjusted EPS reported 11/5/26: $1.22 vs GS est $1.16 and consensus est $1.04.
F4Q26 EBITDA reported: $297 mn vs GS est $301 mn and FactSet consensus est $301 mn.
F4Q26 total production reported: 1,130 MMcfe/d vs GS est 1,190 and consensus est 1,188.
F4Q26 capex reported: $346 mn vs GS est $324 mn and consensus est $322 mn.
F4Q26 operating cash flow before working capital changes reported: $289 mn vs GS est $248 mn and consensus est $241 mn. Cash flow per share reported $3.04 vs GS est $2.59 and consensus est $2.78.
F4Q26 realized natural gas price reported: $2.80/Mcf vs GS est $2.75/Mcf. Total cash costs reported $0.58/Mcfe vs GS est $0.52, and all-in costs $1.39 vs GS est $1.32.
F4Q26 segment EBITDA reported vs GS est: Integrated Upstream & Gathering $241 mn vs $248 mn, Pipeline and Storage $61 mn vs $60 mn, Utility $3 mn vs -$2 mn, Other -$9 mn vs -$5 mn.

F2027 company guidance: adjusted EPS $6.00-$6.40 based on $2.85/MMBtu NYMEX. Total production 400-435 Bcf vs GS est 425 Bcf and consensus est 424 Bcf. Capex $1,090-$1,220 mn vs consensus est $1,075 mn.
risk_factors: F4Q26 production came in 5% below estimates and capex 7-8% above, with the drivers to be addressed on the call.
F2027 production guidance of 400-435 Bcf has a midpoint of 417.5 Bcf, below the GS (425) and consensus (424) estimates.
F2027 capex guidance of $1,090-$1,220 mn has a midpoint of $1,155 mn, above the $1,075 mn consensus.
The planned spin-off of the Integrated Upstream and Gathering business is an open question for the call.
